    for _ in range(160):
        s.step(s.low.task.normalize_action(base))

    starts, goals = [], []
    for actuators, tip_id, target in zip(arm_sets, tip_bodies, targets):
        adr = np.array([s.model.jnt_qposadr[s.model.actuator_trnid[i, 0]] for i in actuators])
        lo, hi = s.model.actuator_ctrlrange[actuators, 0], s.model.actuator_ctrlrange[actuators, 1]
        start = s.data.qpos[adr].copy()
        starts.append(start)
        ik_data.qpos[:] = s.data.qpos[:]
        mujoco.mj_forward(s.model, ik_data)
        snapshot = ik_data.qpos.copy()

        def residual(q):
            ik_data.qpos[:] = snapshot
            ik_data.qpos[adr] = q
            mujoco.mj_forward(s.model, ik_data)
            return np.r_[20.0 * (ik_data.xpos[tip_id] - target), 0.01 * (q - start)]

        result = least_squares(residual, np.clip(start, lo, hi), bounds=(lo, hi), max_nfev=100)
        goals.append(result.x.copy())

    for k in range(1, 81):

        s.step(s.low.task.normalize_action(ctrl))

    for actuators, goal in zip(arm_sets, goals):
        hold[actuators] = goal
    for _ in range(s.max_steps - len(rec.actions)):

        progress = float(np.exp(-np.linalg.norm(obj - goal) / 0.5))
        stable = float(np.exp(-root_speed))
